name: DG CrA

paper.title: Planet-forming disks and their environment across regions and time from the full NIR census

notes: First-published SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (DESTINYS). One of the most prominent DESTINYS detections: a stellar companion is seen 0.22" S of the primary in the intensity image, and a highly sub-structured disk is detected out to 1" with several spiral arms extending to 2.5" in polarized light, including one prominent NE arm connecting to the surrounding environment. Disk features: narrow shadow(s); ambient features: binary interaction + ambient interaction (Garufi et al. 2026, Table A.5/Fig. A.1).
